matter: A cover of grey-blue card, the library's, with a white label at the lower left: «<36626359630013», with a red «S» stamped beside it, «<36626359630013» and «Bayer. Staatsbibliothek»; the print of the title of the wrapper (frame 003) shows faintly on the card in mirror image. Not part of the edition.

In ink at the top: «A la Bibliothèque Royale / de Munich / B. Boncompagni», the editor's inscription presenting the copy to the Royal Library in Munich, with his signature; at the upper left, in ink, the shelfmark «4° Math. U. 9», with a raised «u» underlined, and a faint mark after it; a short word in pencil at the right, «Rat» or «Kat». The stamp «BIBLIOTHECA REGIA MONACENSIS», rectangular and faded, in the middle of the page, below L10; the oval stamp «Bayerische Staatsbibliothek München» of the back of the wrapper shows through, in mirror image, below L16. Not part of the edition.
